At line 11: name = mapper.map(getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName())) - Here zipEntry.getName() is used again
At line 18: File tmp2 = file.getParentFile() - tmp2 is assigned the parent directory of the file
At line 19: FileUtils.forceMkdir(tmp2) - tmp2 is used here

The key dependency chain is:

2. zipEntry.getName() is also used at line 11 in the getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()) call
3. The result of getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()) is used to create the file path
4. The file path is used to create the File object at line 13
5. The parent of this file (line 18) becomes tmp2
6. tmp2 is then used at line 19

Since tmp2 is derived from the file path which depends on zipEntry.getName(), and zipEntry.getName() is used at line 2 (which is before line 19), the value of tmp2 used at line 19 does depend on the value of zipEntry.getName() (and thus the value of zipEntry) at line 1.
